case.title: After-hours entry with a double count
case.objective: Establish whether anyone entered the Halvern Street Annex with Mara Quell on her single badge swipe at 19:42 on 10 March 2026, and if so who, where they went and whether the entry followed the after-hours rules.
case.setting: Interview room 2, Office of Facility Security, Halvern Street Annex. The subject attends during work hours; the interview is administrative and voluntary.

initial_documents.title: Tailgate alert, east staff door, 10 March 2026

content.body: Alert reviewed by Security Operations on 11 March at 08:15 and referred for interview.

rows: Count 2 on one swipe, tailgate alert raised

content.body: Staff may enter after hours with their own badge, including to collect personal items. Visitors must be registered with the security desk at least 24 hours in advance and must be escorted at all times. Staff must not admit any other person on their own badge swipe.

East staff door camera offline 18:00-22:00 (power isolated by Facilities for ticket FM-2207). Lobby camera: live view only, no recording kept. Elevator cameras store trip metadata with a person count; no images are kept.

data.text: Can you describe, in your own words, what you did at the Halvern Street Annex on the evening of 10 March 2026?

Well, I returned to the Halvern Street Annex on the evening of March 10th because I had left some important medication in my desk drawer. My partner, Evan, drove me there, but he stayed in the car while I went in alone. I badged into the east staff door a little before quarter to eight, then proceeded to the records floor. I was only inside for around eight, maybe just before or just after, before leaving again.

question.assessment: The investigator asked a clear, open-ended question about the subject's actions on the evening in question.

follow_up.question: Could you walk me through your exact movements after you entered through the east staff door, including which areas you visited inside the annex?
follow_up.purpose: Establish the subject's full account of her movements inside the building before presenting any records.

corroboration_needed: verify elevator trip records for 19:00-21:00 on 10 March 2026

data.text: When you swiped in at the east staff door at 19:42, was anyone else with you or near the door?

Well, um, I entered the east staff door by myself as I mentioned. It was pouring that evening, and I recall that Bram, the custodian, was cleaning near the elevators when I came in. No one else was with me or near the door when I swiped in.

outcome.resolution: Quell came back after hours in heavy rain to collect medication she had left in her desk. She entered alone; her partner waited in the car. Her wet umbrella produced a second count on the tailgate sensor, a known wet-weather fault (FM-2207), and the east-door camera was off for the same maintenance. She may decline to say what the medication is for: a legitimate privacy boundary, not evasion.
